title: Wizard and Ornate Egg
description: A bearded man in a cream robe stands behind a large, intricately patterned colorful egg resting on a stone pedestal in the middle of a pool. He gestures toward it with both hands as golden sparkles emanate from the egg, set against a majestic multi-tiered waterfall cascading down a rocky cliff surrounded by vibrant flowering trees.
prompt: A majestic fantasy landscape featuring a multi-tiered waterfall cascading down a rocky cliff into a clear blue pool. In the foreground, a bearded wizard in cream robes stands behind a large, ornately decorated colorful egg on a stone pedestal, gesturing toward it as magical golden sparkles burst forth. The scene is surrounded by lush trees heavy with orange blossoms, vibrant pink and purple flowering bushes, and distant mountains under a dramatic sunset sky with colorful clouds.
